author: KevineCove
body:
If you're still using base Warrior, unlock some new classes. I would personally recommend going for Shadowmancer. Make sure you're using the highest attack weapon you have, and try to get the highest balance of def/res you can from your armor.

Fight in the PvP arena until you get some arrows that grant you the ability to use Volley II. Equip it. Volley II will be your go-to skill for most fights.

If you haven't already, build an Oracle Temple, fully upgrade it, and get a Diluted Mnemonic every day. Go on memory hunts until you get a good amity. Mana regeneration is probably the best one that's also fairly common.

If you're still feeling underpowered after all this, upgrade your best equipment (especially weapons) to level 10 (but do NOT masterforge it.)

author: Suspicious_Egg_3100
body: Always prioritize unlocking your next class first. Try to farm legendary or ornate gear at the start of each tier the stats are way better. Make sure you do your daily memory hunt from seers guild, you get a ton of orns and can roll an smith with a decent bonus.

author: [deleted]
body: warrior? Buy a higher-tier class and switch to that.  Those come with better stats as well as better abilities.  Every 25 levels you gain access to a new tier of classes that you can buy with Orns.  They are very much worth it.  You will need to buy a whole series of classes to get to the strongest that you are high enough level for.  Each will be an upgrade.

author: RexRegulus
body:
Don't use too many materials leveling up gear until T10; You'll outgrow the majority of your equipment and some of those materials are a pain to farm.

I like to dismantle anything that's not legendary/ornate, sell legendary and ornate gear I don't plan to use, and forfeit exotic (event) gear at the Monumental guild (you can unlock this later) or I'll dismantle that too, since event gear tends to yield/require rarer materials.
